name: Bennie Tinson
office: City of Compton, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Bennie Tinson is the executive director of LARCA, a nonprofit that partners with the Los Angeles County Department of Mental Health on homelessness. He previously worked as a paralegal in the Compton City Attorney’s Office and as an SEIU union organizer.

sentences.text: Bennie Tinson is the executive director of LARCA, a nonprofit that partners with the Los Angeles County Department of Mental Health on homelessness.
He previously worked as a paralegal in the Compton City Attorney’s Office and as an SEIU union organizer.

items.text: His campaign says he wants to repair roads and modernize drainage. He supports installing speed bumps and removing commercial trucks from residential streets. His priorities include stopping sex trafficking on Long Beach Boulevard and attracting mixed-use housing. He also wants to stop industrial pollution and eliminate graffiti within 24 hours. He says he wants to bring transparency to city governance.
